toolCalls.name: run_sql
toolCalls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        yr,
        SUM(cnt) AS total_rentals
    FROM bike_sharing_hourly
    GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT 
    t2011.total_rentals AS rentals_2011,
    t2012.total_rentals AS rentals_2012,
    t2012.total_rentals - t2011.total_rentals AS absolute_growth,
    ROUND(100.0 * (t2012.total_rentals - t2011.total_rentals) / t2011.total_rentals, 2) AS pct_growth
FROM (SELECT total_rentals FROM yearly WHERE yr = 0) t2011,
     (SELECT total_rentals FROM yearly WHERE yr = 1) t2012;","purpose":"Calculate absolute and percentage growth in total rentals from 2011 to 2012"}
